verticalDatum: Public Terrarium composite source heights; provider-relative host visualization, not a surveyed local datum.
attribution: Mapzen terrain tiles; NASA/USGS and other open elevation sources
method: Original Terrarium RGB24 bytes bilinearly sampled at pixel centres in fixed native whole KV46 rock-cut tomb structure frame. Independent field frozen before any model geometry, without flattening or fitting.
limitations: Terrarium zoom15 output pixels may oversample much coarser native DEM.1m review grid and RGB encoding are not survey accuracy.

Unclassified steep hillside source relief may contain wall/canopy artifacts and does not resolve subterranean floors, overburden/ceiling contact, entrance thresholds or ancient stair grades. Exact construction-grade classification is unspecified; source field does not certify ground contact.
